s: Hilkot tzitzit vaatipato, ubo l' seipim: kol haqqore "qeriat shema" belo tzitzit — meid edut sheqer beatzmo. Vehoil shekkol adam tzarik lihyot zahir vezariz lehaqdim hammitzva bekol mah deepshar, laken tekep umiyyad achar netilat yadayim sheyyadayv neqiyyot veyakol lebarek — yitattep batztzitzit:
Ukesheyyatchil lehitattep qodem sheyyitattep legamre — yebarek meummad "lehitattep batztzitzit" (ayyen besiman kah vetimtza taam al zeh). Habb' shel "batztzitzit" tehe nequda be'pattach':

Kol birkot hammitzvot tzarik lihyot meummad, chutz mibbirkat hashshechita vehaprashat challa sheenan mitzva kol kak, sheeno oseh ella letaqqen maakalo. Abal asiyyat hammitzvot atzman — yesh mehen sheen tzerikim lihyot meummad, veyesh mehen shetztzerikim, kaasher yitbaer kol echad veechad bimqomo besiyyata dishmayya:

Haatipa betzitzit — ameru chaza"l shetztzarik lihyot davqa meummad, umatzeu lahem semek veremez min hattora, neemar kan batztzitzit "vehaya lakem", veneemar baomer "usepartem lakem" — mah "lakem" haamur baomer tzarik lihyot meummad, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman besiman tapat — ap kan meummad:

Yesh omerim middetiqqenu chaza"l lebarek "lehitattep batztzitzit", mikkelal dehammitzva hi lehitattep davqa. Vekol atipa sheenah kaatipat hayyishmeelim — enah niqret atipa, ella lebisha. Velaken tzarik lehitattep betallito kaatipat hayyishmeelim, dehaynu lekassot harosh im happanim ad gummot shebballechi lematta mippiv. Uledibrehem tallitot qetannot shellanu, sheen bahen atipat harosh — peturin mitztzitzit legamre:

Abal yesh omerim shekkol kesut shel arba kenapot ap-al-pi sheen bah ittup — chayyebet betzitzit, shehare neemar battora "al kanpe bigdehem", vekol malbush ubeged bemashma, vehaittup en lo apillu remez battora kelal. Umah shettiqqenu chakamim lebarek "lehitattep batztzitzit", haynu lepi shehaya minhagam laatop rosham betallitam, veap bimehem lo hayu mitattepin kaatipat hayyishmeelim, ella kederek bene adam shemmitattepin biksutam veoseqin bimlaktam, paam bekissuy harosh upaam begilluy harosh, laken ap anachnu ap sheanu mebarekin "lehitattep batztzitzit" — en anu tzerikin yoter. Vahalaka kassebara hashsheniyya. Umikkol maqom kede leqayyem mitzvat tzitzit min hammubchar — nakon haddabar lehitattep kaatipat hayyishmeelim bishat beraka, veyaamod kak kede hilluk arba ammot, ubazeh yotze ap lassebara harishona, deiqqar haqqepeda hi bishat lebisha, deha im haya rotzeh haya mesirah mimmennu legamre achar kak:

Veken yaaseh betallitot qetannim shellanu, ap-al-pi deqayma lan deyotzein bah yede chobat tzitzit, ap-al-pi sheen bahem ittup, mikkol maqom kede latzet ledibre hakkol, im rotzeh lebarek "lehitattep batztzitzit" — tob sheyyaniach hattallit qatan al rosho verochab hattallit yihyeh leqomato, shekken hu derek haittup, veyaamod kak meuttap lepachot kede hilluk arba ammot, veachar-kak yimshekennu meal rosho veyilbeshennu. Vedavqa bebeged sheosin keen chatika achat merubbaat ubet hatztzavvar baemtza, veim ken keshemmitattep beorko [sebib] rosho verochab gupo kemo shennitbaer dezehu davqa miqre ittup — have leh shette tzitzit mitztzad zeh ushette tzitzit mitztzad zeh. Abal im habbeged tapur, im ken kesheyyitattep beorko sebib rosho verochab gupo — azay yabou kol haarba tzitzit mitztzad echad, velo nakon laasot ken kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman, laken yilbeshennu kedarko velo yitattep bo kelal al rosho, velo yebarek alayv "lehitattep batztzitzit", ella yebarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al mitzvat tzitzit". Veken apillu al tallit qatan heasuy mechatika achat merubbaat veeno tapur, im lobesho kedarko veen meattep bo rosho — mebarek gam ken "al mitzvat tzitzit":

Otan sheen mitkassim betallitam ella harosh usebib hatztzavvar bilbad, veen maqpidin lekassot et haggup — tzarik limchot beyadam, deiqqar haittup hu baggup lekulle alma, velo nechlequ besaip h ella im tzarik gam ken lekassot harosh betallito, abal kissuy harosh bilbad beli kissuy haggup — lekulle alma lo niqra kesut kelal (ayyen siman yod):

Nahagu laasot atara lattallit mechatikat meshi, lesiman sheotan tzitzit shellepanayv yihyu leolam lepanayv velo yoriden lematta, shemmaalin baqqodesh veen moridin. Vehaari"y z"l lo haya maqpid al zeh. Tob lizzaher shebbishat atipa yizroq kol haarba tzitzit letzad semol kaatipat hayyishmeelim, kede hilluk arba ammot:
Yachazi[y]r shette tzitzit lepanayv ushette tzitzit leacharayv, kede sheyyehe mesubbab bemitzvot. Yesh nohagin lasum tzad yamin al katep semol, kede sheyyihyeh mesubbab bemitzvot:

Im kamma anashim mitattepim kol echad betallito bebat achat — kol echad mebarek leatzmo. Veim ratzu — haechad mebarek vehaacherim shomein veonin amen veyotzein bazeh, deshomea kimdabber. Abal adam acher sheeno mitattep akshav betzitzit — eno yakol lebarek kede liptor et hammitattep, kevan shehu atzmo en tzarik lebarek akshav beraka. Veim hammitattep hu bur sheeno yodea lebarek — yakol lebarek lo acher ap-al-pi sheen tzarik akshav libraka zo, kevan shekkol yisrael arebim zeh bazeh, im ken gam hu tzarik libraka zo akshav (laken nohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur mebarek beqol ram, kede lehotzi et mi sheeno baqi). Veken haddin bekol birkot hammitzvot:

Hattora qeraatan "tzitzit", veen leshon "tzitzit" ella chutin nipradin, kemo searot hannipradin, kemo shekkatub: "vayyiqqacheni betzitzit roshi". Al ken tzarik lehaprid hachutin zeh mizzeh qodem habberaka. Veim nishtaha labo lebet hakkeneset, ubeod sheyyaprid hatztzitzit yitbattel millehitpallel im hatztzibbur — en tzarik lehapridan:

Bekol yom vayom qodem sheyyebarek — tzarik sheyyeayyen bechute hatztzitzit im hem kesherim, shemma nipsequ mehem ezo chutin. Veken tzarik leayyen beoto cheleq shel tzitzit hammunnach al kenap habbeged, shemma nipsaq chut echad. Veap-al-pi shebbadaq hatztzitzit etmol — tzarik lachazor ulebodqam lemachar, veen omerim haamiden al chezqatan shehem akshav kemo [shehayu] temol shilshom, mishshum deim lo yibdeqem bishat habberaka — lo yibdeqem leolam, ubevadday i epshar lehaamidan leolam bechezqat kashrut, kevan sheddarkan lipsoq al yede derisat haraglayim o mechamat sibbot acherot, laken tiqqenu chakamim sheyyibdoq bekol yom vayom. Abal beoto hayyom shekkebar bedaqan paam achat — shub en tzarik lebodqan, apillu im hesir tallito mealayv vehissiach dato millilbash od veachar-kak beemtza hayyom nimlak lelobsho — en tzarik lebodqan. Umuttar latzet bahen kak beli bediqa apillu lirshut harabbim beshabbat, mippene shemmaamidin otan al chezqatan, shehare hayu shelemim beoto hayyom keshebbedaqan bashshachar:

Mi shellabash harbeh begadim shel tzitzit zeh al gabbe zeh, ap-al-pi shebbibraka achat nipteru kullam — mikkol maqom tzarik libdoq hatztzitzit shel kol echad veechad bipne atzmo, shemma nipsaq chut echad mitztzitzit shel echad mehem, venimtza lobesh arba kenapot belo tzitzit:

Mi shennishtaha labo lebet hakkeneset ubeod sheyyitasseq bibdiqat hatztzitzit yitbattel millehitpallel im hatztzibbur, veken mi shebba lebet hakkeneset uqerauhu laalot leseper tora, vaadayin lo labash tallito, kevan shehatztzibbur mamtinin alayv, laken mishshum torach hatztzibbur — rashshay lilbosh hattallit belo bediqat hatztzitzit, dekkevan shehu yodea sheetmol hayu hatztzitzit shelemot — maamidin otan bechezqatan:
Im badaq tallito vehinnicho bemaqom yadua ulemachar metzao kemo shehinnicho — en tzarik libdoq, devadday lo nipselu hatztzitzit benetayim:
Kesheyyitattep batztzitzit, yekavven: shetztzivvanu haqqadosh-baruk-hu lehitattep batztzitzit kede shennizkor kol mitzvotayv laasotam, shenneemar: "ureitem oto uzekartem et kol mitzvot Hashem":

Vekevan shettaam lebishat hatztzitzit hu kede lizkor hammitzvot, lepikak hallobesh tallit qatan yizzaher lelobsho al begadayv, kede shettamid yirehu veyizkor hammitzvot. Veotan hallobeshim oto tachat habbegadim — yizzaharu sheyyilbeshu oto beopen sheyyerau hatztzitzit tamid, sheal yede reiyyatan — yizkeru hammitzvot tamid:

Tzarik sheyyihyu hatztzitzit mibbachutz, shenneemar: "ureitem oto", udela keotan shettochabin oto behakkenapot. Ubishat haddechaq, kegon sheholek ben hannokrim vechoshesh shello yaligu alayv — yakol letochobam behakkenapot, ak bishat habberaka yihyu megullin lepachot kede hilluk arba ammot:

Im rotzeh lilbosh hattallit qatan miyyad bequmo, kede shello yelek arba ammot belo tzitzit, vahare adayin en yadayv neqiyyot velo yakol lebarek — yakol lelobsho belo beraka, veliksheyyenaqqeh yadayv yemashmesh betzitziyyotayv vibarek, dehammishmush hu keillu lobesho akshav. Veim bedato lehitattep betallit acheret miyyad kesheyyenaqqeh yadayv — en tzarik lemashmesh be[zu] ulebarek aleha, raq yebarek al hattallit shellobesh achar-kak, vikavven bemachashabto liptor gam et zot shellabash kebar:

Im yesh lo kamma begadim shel arba kenapot — kullam chayyabim betzitzit, apillu lobeshan kullan keachat, shenneemar: "al kanpe bigdehem" — harbeh begadim bemashma. Veim lobeshan kullam zeh achar zeh beli hepseq sicha benetayim, vehaya dato mittechilla bishat habberaka lelobsham kullam miyyad — lo yebarek ella beraka achat lekullam, apillu im pashat harishon qodem shellabash hashsheni. Abal im hipsiq benehem besicha o bidbarim acherim — tzarik lebarek al kol echad veechad. Vedavqa shehipsiq shello letzorek lebisha, abal letzorek lebisha kegon sheamar tenu li habbeged — en tzarik lebarek. Veken im lo haya bedato mittechilla bishat beraka lelobsham kullam miyyad, ap-al-pi shennimlak achar-kak ulebasham kullam zeh achar zeh, mikkol maqom kevan shemmittechilla lo haya dato ken — hava kemapsiq, vetzarik lebarek al kol mah shennimlak achar sheggamar lilbosh habbegadim shehaya dato alehen bishat habberaka. Abal im hebiu lo od begadim lilbosh kesheadayin haya munnach lepanayv meotan habbegadim shehaya dato alehen bishat habberaka velo lebashan adayin beshaa shennimlak lilbosh gam ellu habbegadim shehebiu lo akshav — azay lo yachazor vibarek al ellu habbegadim shehebiu lo akshav, kevan shello gamar adayin lebishat begadim harishonim shekkebar berak alehem — hare zeh domeh [lemi] shello gamar seudato vehebiu lo od leekol, deen tzarik lachazor ulebarek:

Im lobesh tallit qatan bebeto ap-al-pi shebberak alayv "lehitattep batztzitzit", veal derek shennitbaer, mikkol maqom im achar-kak holek lebet hakkeneset umitattep betallit gadol — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv gam ken "lehitattep", veeno niptar babberaka harishona, mishshum dehahalika mibbeto lebet hakkeneset chashub hepseq veap im lo hipsiq beshum sicha benetayim, vaapillu haya beto samuk lebet hakkeneset. Velo od, ella im apillu rotzeh lehitattep betallit gadol bebeto, raq sheqqodem shemmitattep betallit gadol yatza chutz lepetach beto vechazar — have hepseq ben habberaka shebberak al hattallit qatan lilbishat hattallit gadol, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek. Abal im lo yatza mippetach beto benetayim, apillu im berak al tallit qatan becheder zeh veholek lehitattep betallit gadol becheder acher beoto habbayit — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kevan sheshshene hachadarim hem bebayit echad — lo chashub hepseq mah sheholek mizzeh lazeh, im eno mapsiq besicha o bidbarim acherim.

Happoshet tallito ubeshaa shepposhet dato lachazor velilbash miyyad — en tzarik lebarek alayv kesheyyachazor veyilbashennu miyyad, apillu lo nishar alayv tallit qatan, apillu poshet bebayit zeh vechozer velobesho bebayit acher — lo have hepseq, kevan shechozer velobesh oto hattallit beatzmo shekkebar berak alayv, vegam lo hissiach dato kelal millebishato, laken niptar babberaka shebberak alayv keshellebasho bepaam rishona. Abal im kesheppeshato lo haya dato lachazor velilbash ad leachar kamma shaot, azay apillu im achar-kak nimlak lelobsho tekep umiyyad — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv, apillu nishar alayv tallit qatan, vaapillu im lo yatza mippetach beto kelal benetayim vechozer velobesho beoto hacheder shepposheto:

Veken apillu im kesheppeshato haya dato lachazor ulelobsho miyyad, ella sheachar-kak shakach o nimlak millilbash ad leachar kamma shaot — azay tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv, apillu lo yatza mippetach beto kelal benetayim vechozer velobesho beoto hacheder shepposheto:

Happoshet tallito setam, shello haya bedato kelum: lo sheyyachazor veyilbashennu miyyad, velo shello yachazor veyilbashennu miyyad, im kesheppashat hattallit nishar adayin alayv tallit qatan, im ken lo hissiach dato mehammitzva, laken kesheyyachazor veyilbosh et hattallit sheppashat mittechilla — en tzarik lebarek alayv. Abal im kesheppashat hattallit lo nishar alayv shum beged sheyyesh bo tzitzit, im ken hissiach dato legamre min hammitzva, laken kesheyyachazor veyilbosh et hattallit sheppashat — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv:

Mi shehaya labush tallit venopla mimmennu, kesheyyachazor veyitattep bah — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kevan shennopla shello middato, laken eno moil kelum mah sheddato sheyyachazor veyilbashennu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Shennopla kullah meal gupo, abal im miqtzatah nishar al gupo ap-al-pi shennopla rubbah — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kevan shennishar alayv qetzat mehammitzva. Vedavqa sheoto miqtzat shello napal nishar munnach al gupo, abal im nishar munnach al yado, kevan sheen mitzva kelal bahanachato al hayyad, shehare iqqar haittup hu baggup, im ken hare lo nishar alayv mehammitzva kelum, velaken keshechozer umitattep ba — tzarik lachazor ulebarek:

Kol beged sheyyesh bo arbaa kenapot shehu meyuchad lehitlabbesh bo bayyom, im lo peshato ballayla raq shennishar alayv ad habboqer — en tzarik lebarek alayv babboqer, kevan deyesh omerim shekkesut yom chayyab lehatil bo tzitzit ap im rotzeh lelobsho ballayla, im ken lo haya kan zeman petor lebeged zeh, velaken en hallayla mapseqet kelal, ukeyoma ariketta dami. Umikkol maqom, kevan deyesh omerim (ayyen siman yach) shekkesut yom petura mitztzitzit im rotzeh lehitlabbesh bah ballayla, veim ken hare abar zeman petor lebeged zeh vahave hepseq, ap shehu melubbash behatztzitzit kol hallayla, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu patur mitztzitzit baet hahi — hare zeh domeh kemo shello hayu alayv hatztzitzit kelal kol hallayla, vetzarik lachazor ulebarek alehen kesheyyaggia zeman chiyyubam babboqer, laken kede latzet ledibre hakkol — tob sheyyebarek al tallit acher veyiptor gam et zeh shellan bo:
Asur lehitkassot bebeged shehu chayyab betzitzit velo hetil bo tzitzit, veim lobesho — ober al mitzvat aseh, shehare bittel mitzvat tzitzit:
Mi shehaya mitpallel tepillat shemoneh esreh venapal tallito mealayv vehenichu acherim alayv et hattallit, kesheyyesayyem et tepillato — yemashmesh batztzitzit vibarek:
Hayyashen bayyom — tob shello yasir mealayv hattallit qatan legamre, raq sheyyitkasseh bo beet hashshena, ukeshellobesho achar-kak — en tzarik beraka, kevan shello hesir mimmennu legamre:
